'''Sector six''' was a sector within the [[Castilon system]]. Prior to the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang]] attacked a [[Darius G-class freighter|''Darius G''-class freighter]] carrying several [[kowakian monkey-lizard]]s and a [[kowakian ape-lizard]]. The [[Resistance]] [[pilot]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] along with their [[BB-series astromech droid]]s [[BB-8]] and [[CB-23]] [[Investigation of a G-class freighter|investigated]] the incident and managed to rescue the [[pirate]] [[Synara San]].<ref name="Signal" />
